answer_4.quote: To further evaluate topic coherence and semantic clarity, we conduct a qualitative comparison across models using the Yelp Reviews dataset. For this analysis, we manually inspect two representative topics generated by each model and summarize them using the top five topic words.
answer_4.guideline: Manually inspect topics and summarize with top words to evaluate coherence and semantic clarity.
